candidates.detail: An authorized immediate activity admits one to 24 whole hours, settles and commits the actual injury/disease-clipped personal interval, constructs an allocation from effective elapsed minutes, then passes MINUTES_PER_DAY as the elapsed argument to apply_training. That day-sized value correctly supplies the reference basis for daily scheduled minutes, but the helper also treats the same value as actual ambient settlement time: it awards oral-language exposure at elapsed/60 times two-thirds and each local language share. For a nonterminal one-hour activity, this calculates 16 ambient hours rather than two-thirds of an hour before the local share, aptitude multiplier and cap. The resulting direct language hours are retained in CharacterSkills. All shorter intervals are overcounted relative to that source policy, subject to the cap and positive share; the one-day interval has the same basis. No product operation was executed.
candidates.source_derived_example: Assume an otherwise-valid, nonterminal one-hour settlement activity at the authored Riverdale demo profile, a direct EastCentral value of 0 hours and Instinct 2.0. Riverdale uses 1,000 basis points EastCentral. The actual helper supplies 16 * 0.1 = 1.6 real language-training hours; aptitude 2.0 yields multiplier 0.75 and accepts approximately 1.2 effective hours under its 2,000-hour cap. Using 60 actually elapsed minutes with the same two-thirds policy yields approximately 0.05 effective hours: 24 times less before rounding. The initial language generator seeds a single vernacular and leaves others zero before any life-simulation adjustments, while a fallback character construction sets Instinct 2.0; this does not prove that a particular authorized player action starts in the assumed combination. No database state or observed gameplay outcome is asserted.
candidates.safeguards: The browser route checks selected character and location, validates whole-hour duration, and the reducer repeats authority, location, duration and relevant organization checks. Injury and disease can clip or terminate the action, and the helper caps accepted gain by aptitude and records excess; cap saturation can mask direct-hour gain and excess has a separate morale consumer. The 24-hour case does not have this elapsed-basis discrepancy. These safeguards do not equate the 1,440-minute training reference with a shorter actual interval.
candidates.connected_scope: Separate actual elapsed duration from normalized daily allocation across immediate activities and apply_training; preserve scheduled and religious training, organization accrual, book training, exact clipped duration, aptitude caps and excess-morale effects; inspect rest, stationary, camp, all other callers, skill serialization and historical alias inventory.

Use actual elapsed for ambient language, and preserve scheduled, organization, prayer and reading calculations plus caps, excess and terminal behavior. Do not introduce compatibility paths.

Preserve intended scheduled, organization, reading, prayer, rest and camp gains, recorded excess and clocks.
